name: Sachiko no Koufuku-ron
source:
Sachiko, a young married woman, has moved in next door. She's cheerful, friendly, and kind. "Neighbors are supposed to get along, right?"

One night, you visit her house.
Her husband is sleeping in the bedroom just beyond the door.

You must not make a sound.
You must not be discovered.

A short touch game of depravity and horror that can be played in 30 minutes.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01755201.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
年轻的人妻幸子搬到了隔壁。她开朗、亲切又温柔体贴。“街坊邻居本来就该好好相处嘛，对吧？”

某天夜晚，你登门拜访了她的家。
一门之隔的卧室里，她的丈夫正酣然熟睡。

绝不能发出半点声响。
绝不能被人发现。

一款30分钟即可通关的背德与恐怖短篇触摸互动游戏。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01755201.html]DLsite[/url]]
